name: yakyard
description: Self-hosted team chat on Cloudflare: channels, threads, DMs, calls, voice notes with transcripts.

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.mjs packages/yakyard-lock/test/*.test.mjs && node scripts/lock-sync.mjs --check && python3 test/security.py
scripts.site:deploy: npm run site:build && wrangler deploy --config site/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.lock:build: npm --prefix packages/yakyard-lock run build:wasm && node scripts/lock-sync.mjs

SETUP_TOKEN.description: A long random code (at least 24 characters) that only you know. You type it once on the setup page to create the owner account. Make one with `openssl rand -hex 24` or any password manager.

VAPID_PRIVATE.description: Optional, for phone notifications. Leave empty for now; see **Notifications** in the README.

TOKEN_KEY.description: Optional, only for the Slack import: base64 of 32 random bytes (`openssl rand -base64 32`).

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional, only for Sign in with Google.

SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional, only for the Slack import.

TURN_KEY_ID.description: Optional: Cloudflare Realtime TURN key id, so calls work behind strict networks.

TURN_KEY_TOKEN.description: Optional: Cloudflare Realtime TURN key token.
